The '''Vicondor system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Vorc sector/Legends|Vorc sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vicondor/Legends|Vicondor]].
